metadata.interpolation: source LINEAR matrix samples; quaternion interpolation is an explicit runtime choice
metadata.reference_pose: first animation sample, NOT a neutral bind pose

conventions.matrix: 16 values in observed affine file row order, column vectors; translation indices 3,7,11; retain raw data
conventions.euler: degrees, R=Rz(z)*Ry(y)*Rx(x); axis-wise unwrapped for reading only; NOT target Blockbench/Minecraft angles
conventions.units: processed translation/positions in meters; raw matrices retain source units
